controls.name: Back link: "‹ Decision support" or "‹ Board"
controls.what: Returns to where Todd came from, with the same view, sort and filter, and names that place (0047).
controls.from: Navigation only. No data.
notes: Drawn with two arrows, a stray "‹" after the arrow. A drawing flaw, not built (R-09).

controls.name: Profile icon
controls.what: A round profile button.
controls.from: Drawn by Stitch as part of its frame. Not built (decision 0008).

controls.name: Project name "Recipes"
controls.what: The Linear project the card belongs to, small and grey above the title.
controls.from: Linear.

controls.name: Label "Complete" or "Closed", plus "Interrupted"
controls.what: The card's final state: Complete or Closed. A small Interrupted label is added when the machine waited on Todd before his UAT yes (0042).
controls.from: Linear status, with the finished-card record (G2).
notes: Only cards that ran have a page (0049).

controls.name: Title "Add a recipe and find it by title"
controls.what: The card's title.
controls.from: Linear.

controls.name: Tile "Cost" ($4.13)
controls.what: What the whole card cost at published API prices, from the runner's kept record (0041).
controls.from: The cost rows in the kept record (G1). The scorecard's "Cost" line.
notes: A value that applies but wasn't captured shows "Not recorded" and is left out of the total, never 0; one that doesn't apply shows N/A (0046).

controls.name: Tile "Start to Complete"
controls.what: Time from Start to the card reaching Complete (its last merge), including time waiting on Todd (0056).
controls.from: Start time from the runner; merge time from GitHub. Both in the kept record.
notes: Full label and value, in a two-by-two grid of tiles on a phone (0043).

controls.name: Tile "Rounds" (2)
controls.what: How many Shipping checks the card needed, one per round (0016).
controls.from: The Shipping checker's results, one per round, in the runner's kept record (B-05, 0041).

controls.name: Tile "HITL interventions" (1)
controls.what: Count and total time of the waits on Todd before his UAT yes, for example "30 · 5 h 17 min" (0045, 0054).
controls.from: The stops in the kept record. Glossary: "Human intervention".

controls.name: Fold "Shipping check", "All proven in round 2"
controls.what: The first folding section, open on load. Its line says the last round's result.
controls.from: The evidence reviews: the Shipping checker's verdicts for each criterion in each round (decision 0016, B-05).
notes: The one fold open on load; the others start closed. "Evidence review" on the picture reads "Shipping check" (0016).

controls.name: Round switch: "Round 1", "Round 2"
controls.what: Chooses which round's verdicts are shown. Opens on the last round.
controls.from: The evidence reviews.
notes: A card with one round has no switch (0051).

controls.name: Three criterion rows with "Proven" pills
controls.what: One row for each "done means" line of the card, with its verdict for the chosen round: Proven (mint) or Not proven (rose, with a cross). Tapping a row shows the checker's one-line reason and the proof file it looked at (0044).
controls.from: The card's criteria and the Shipping checker's verdicts (0016, 0044).
notes: Each row shows its whole text, wrapped (0043).

controls.name: Line "Round 1: 1 not proven"
controls.what: What the other round found, in one line under the rows.
controls.from: The evidence reviews.
notes: Left out on a one-round card (0051).

controls.name: Fold "Cost by role and model" ($4.13 · 3 models)
controls.what: Cost for each role, showing the model asked for and the model that answered, with tokens split into cached, input and output. A row where the two differ is amber and its cost counts against the model that answered; the folded line warns, for example "1 model swapped" (0052, 0053).
controls.from: The runner's kept record; the answering model comes from Mastra's tracing, received live (0041, 0052).

controls.name: Fold "Time per stage" (Longest: UAT 1 h 10 min)
controls.what: How long the card spent in each stage, with time waiting on Todd shown apart from time the machine worked.
controls.from: Stage times in the kept record.
notes: Each stage with its time; time waiting on Todd shown apart (0045).

controls.name: Fold "HITL interventions" (1 · cause: design)
controls.what: Each wait on Todd before his UAT yes: when, how long, its kind (Agent stopped, Question, Stop or Send-back), whether he was pinged and when, the cause and the root-cause stage. Opening a row shows what the agent last said and what Todd replied. A wait with no ping is rose, "Not pinged", and the folded line counts them (0045, 0054, 0055).
controls.from: The stops with their cause and root-cause stage (B-04).

controls.name: Fold "Context", with "Compactions · 2" on its right
controls.what: Per agent: its model, compactions, handoffs and the fullest its context got; each compaction's detail one tap further. The folded line shows the compaction total when there were any, and nothing when there were none (0045).
controls.from: The compactions, model changes and handoffs the runner records as the card runs (0041).

controls.name: Link "Open in Linear"
controls.what: Opens the card's Linear issue in a new tab.
controls.from: Linear.

controls.name: Link "Open run record"
controls.what: Opens the card's run record in a new tab.
controls.from: The run record, which is deleted once the card's retro is complete (B-06).
notes: After the retro, replaced by the grey words "Run record deleted" (0048).

controls.name: Empty, loading and failed states (not drawn)
controls.what: Loading shows grey placeholder tiles and folds. Failed says "Server unavailable" with Try again, never a no-record message. A page with no record behind it says "No record for this card." (0049, 0050).
controls.from: Fixed text (R-08).
notes: Not drawn either: a Slices fold on cards built in slices, each slice with its pull request, Todd's yes, merge time, cost and HITL interventions (0056).

gaps.res: Decided (0041): the runner records each card as it runs (stops, compactions, model changes, handoffs, time per stage, tokens and cost) into a record kept for good. This page reads only that.
gaps.text: Where the page's numbers live once the card's run record is deleted. The run record, with its trace, is deleted after the card's retro is complete (B-06). Everything on this page (verdicts, costs by model, stage times, stops, compactions) would go with it if the page read from there. Proposed: when a card finishes, the machine saves its numbers as a kept record, and this page and Decision support read only that. Deleting the trace never touches it.

gaps.res: Decided (0042, narrowed by 0049): every card that ran and reached Complete or was closed gets a page, labelled Complete or Closed, plus Interrupted if the machine waited on Todd before his yes.
gaps.text: Which cards get this page, and what the pill says. The picture shows a card that is Complete. Decision support also counts cards that finished with stops, and a card Todd abandoned. Proposed: a page for every card that has reached Complete or that Todd closed; the pill says Complete or Closed, and a card that had stops before Todd's yes gets a second small pill "Not first time" (the scorecard's "Success: no").

gaps.res: Decided (0043): a two-by-two grid of tiles on a phone with full labels; criterion rows wrap.
gaps.text: The tile labels ("Start to m…", "Times ste…") and the criterion rows are cut off in the picture, which breaks R-06 (labels and values are never cut off). Proposed: the four tiles become a two-by-two grid on a phone with the full label and value, and each criterion row shows its whole text, wrapped.

gaps.res: Decided (0044): two verdicts, Proven (mint) and Not proven (rose, with a cross). Tapping a row shows the reason and the proof file.
gaps.text: How the other two verdicts look. Only "Proven" is drawn. Proposed: "Not proven" and "Wrong thing tested" are rose pills with a cross and those words (rose is a problem, R-07). Tapping a criterion row opens the checker's one-line reason and the name of the proof file it looked at.

gaps.res: Decided (0045): Cost by role and model; Time per stage; HITL interventions (every wait on Todd before his yes, with its kind); Context per agent, its folded line showing "Compactions · 2" when there were any.
gaps.text: What is inside the four closed folds, and what counts as a time stepped in. Proposed: Cost by role and model is a small table (role, model, cost, cached/input/output tokens); Time per stage lists each stage with its time and marks the waiting-on-Todd part apart; Times stepped in lists each stop with when, how long, cause and root-cause stage; Compactions lists each round and model with its count. A time stepped in is every stop where the machine waited on Todd before his UAT yes, as in the scorecard.

gaps.res: Decided (0046): "Not recorded" when it applies but wasn't captured (left out of totals, never 0); "N/A" when it doesn't apply.
gaps.text: What a number shows when it was never recorded. Old cards have gaps: JUL-272 to JUL-274 have unpriced rows and "not recorded before tracing". Proposed: a missing value says "Not recorded" or "Unpriced" and is left out of totals; it is never shown as 0.

gaps.res: Decided (0047): back returns to where Todd came from, same view, sort and filter, and names it: "‹ Decision support" or "‹ Board".
gaps.text: Where "‹ Decision support" returns to. Todd may arrive from Map, Ranked or Cards, with a sort and filter set. Proposed: back returns to the same view with the same sort and filter.

gaps.res: Decided (0048): the link becomes the grey words "Run record deleted".
gaps.text: What the "Open run record" link does after the run record is deleted. Story S-16 says the link is gone. Proposed: the link is replaced by the grey line "Run record deleted after the retro", so Todd sees why it is missing.

gaps.res: Decided (0049, 0050): grey placeholders while loading; "Server unavailable" with Try again when it fails; "No record for this card." if a page has no record.
gaps.text: The empty, loading and failed states (R-08). Proposed: loading shows grey placeholder tiles and folds; a card with no kept record says "No record for this card."; failed says "Can't reach the machine." with Try again, never "No record".

gaps.res: Decided (0051): no round switch and no line under the rows.
gaps.text: A card with one round. Proposed: no round switch, and the line under the rows is left out.
